programme.title: The Pirates
programme.desc: Before the founding of the Joseon Dynasty, envoys from China lose the Royal Seal to a whale. A group of bandits attempt to retrieve it for a large reward and run into a group of pirates.

programme.title: The Ultimate Duo
programme.desc: Jae-hyuk teams up with rookie detective Joong-ho. They arrest a thief and discover he may be a culprit of a closed case. They reopen the case yet the investigation runs into obstacles...

programme.title: The Terror, Live
programme.desc: A newsman discovers he's been rigged with a bomb after he has an exclusive interview with a terrorist who blew up a bridge.

programme.title: Fist & Furious
programme.desc: A former detective grants permission to a freelance video journalist to cover his revenge journey on a mob boss whom previously killed his partner during an investigation.

programme.title: The Villainess
programme.desc: Assassin Sook-hee is recruited as a sleeper agent with the promise of freedom after ten years of service. But after secrets from her past destroy her normal life, she decides to take revenge.

programme.title: Second Sister
programme.desc: So-eun, grieving her sister’s suicide after sexual harassment and cyberbullying, teams up with a private investigator Jun-gyeong to uncover the dark truth behind the malicious rumors.

programme.title: The King
programme.desc: Believing power is paramount, Tae-soo aspires to become a prosecutor. As he achieves his goal and rises swiftly to power, he also sees the cruelty of a life at the top hierarchy in 90's Korea.

programme.title: Boy In The Pool
programme.desc: Seok-young bumps into Woo-ju and they get closer after Woo-ju saves her from drowning. They lost touch after Woo-ju moves to Seoul to be a swimmer. Will they be able to meet again?

programme.title: Because I Love You
programme.desc: After an accident, a talented songwriter transforms into a messenger of love by connecting people who having trouble finding love and expressing their feelings.

programme.title: Heartman: Rock And Love
programme.desc: Seung-min, a former rock singer scarred by a humiliating past, reunites with his first love Bo-na. As romance sparks again, hidden secrets and old wounds threaten their second chance.

programme.desc: Olivia’s baby brother William’s first birthday is coming up and Olivia is determined to find him the absolute best gift ever. But what does he want? After much sleuthing, she makes him a homemade xylophone… only to discover he likes the wrapping paper best of all.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Fearless Freddie ‐ The Bedroom Scare Competition is about to begin and each little monster is assigned a different fleshie house. Everything is going great, except for Casper who ends up in a home where one little kid , Fearless Freddie, isn't afraid of ANYTHING. The whole school unites to scare this unscareable fleshie, which catches Graham’s attention as he uses the opportunity to catch as many monsters as possible. Triclops Mistress Of Darkness ‐ Triclops is being bullied by Thatch and his cronies, but she doesn’t have the guts to fight back. But while on her cereal box she notices an advertisement for collectible rings — collect them all to get super powers and become Master of Darkness! Thatch really wants them all too and when he sees the last ring come out of Triclops’s box, he dashes over to steal it from her. That’s too much for Triclops, she recovers the ring and becomes…Mistress of Darkness!

programme.title: New York Gourmet
programme.desc: Get ready for an epic NY food quest! Justine hits Russ & Daughters for iconic bagels, soaks in the vibrant buzz of DeKalb Market, and devours a classic slice of New York pizza. A thrilling, flavor-packed kickoff to the ultimate culinary adventure!

programme.title: New York Gourmet
programme.desc: The flavor journey explodes! Justine explores the Culinary Institute, tastes bold Caribbean-Southern fusion at Essie’s, and grabs sweet cannolis. After a scenic picnic at Buttermilk Falls, she dines at the legendary Moosewood Restaurant!

programme.title: New York Gourmet
programme.desc: A wild market tour awaits! Justine dives into Salt City Market, cooks lakeside burritos at Onondaga Lake, and feasts on smoky Dinosaur BBQ. She tops off this mouthwatering day with gooey peanut butter s’mores in scenic Canandaigua!

programme.title: New York Gourmet
programme.desc: Gourmet thrills roll on! Justine pairs local Living Roots wines with hearty polenta, takes in breathtaking Niagara Falls, and visits the iconic Anchor Bar to devour the original Buffalo wing! Pure flavor meets jaw-dropping sights.

programme.title: New York Gourmet
programme.desc: Justine tackles a classic roast beef lunch in Buffalo before setting sail for the magnificent 1000 Islands and Boldt Castle! Cooking and exploring along scenic waters, she caps off an unforgettable day at the luxurious Sagamore Resort.

programme.title: New York Gourmet
programme.desc: The grand finale sizzles! Justine whips up apple pancakes with fresh syrup at Toad Hill Maple Farm, digs into Saratoga fried chicken, and crowns her epic New York adventure with an unforgettable final feast at River Market Bar and Kitchen!

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Japan
programme.desc: Adam Liaw continues his culinary pilgrimage in Japan, devouring some of the finest miso, Nagoya chicken and Wagyu beef, and meeting a 74-year-old abalone diver.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Japan
programme.desc: In the vast urban sprawl of Tokyo, Adam Liaw explores a food culture that not only sustains the `salaryman' workers in style but retains culinary traditions.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Japan
programme.desc: Adam Liaw checks out the restaurants of food-crazy Tokyo and taste's some interesting dishes including Yakitori made from the reproductive organs of chickens.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Japan
programme.desc: Adam meets a tea master, a Maiko, and a Michelin chef who turns risotto into sushi in the thriving traditional culture of Kyoto.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Japan
programme.desc: Adam Liaw explores Japan's high-energy financial centre, Osaka, and finds the world's best fast food, a sumo wrestler turned chef, and soba noodles to die for.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Japan
programme.desc: In Japan's southern islands of Kyushu and Shikoku, Adam Liaw finds a vibrant, warm culture where the cuisine is as fascinating as its people.

programme.title: Ainsley Eats The Streets
programme.desc: On the first leg of his journey, Ainsley heads to Istanbul, where he encounters slow-roasted sheep's head, season Turkish village food, like loquats stuffed with cumin-spiced meatballs, and braised lamb with young figs.

programme.title: Ainsley Eats The Streets
programme.desc: Ainsley visits the Caribbean, where he ventures down the backstreets in search of the true local food. He spends time with the locals, cooks roti on the beach with Mr Delicious, fries up spectacular fishcakes, and tries the hottest hot sauce ever.

programme.title: Ainsley Eats The Streets
programme.desc: Ainsley travels to Reykjavik, Iceland, to discover a truly exciting traditional and modern cuisine. She prepares a local classic of langoustines in garlic butter, and there is also gravadlax and ceviche, malted bread, and cakes cooked in a geyser.

programme.title: Ainsley Eats The Streets
